# KokoLearn

> Personalised, curriculum-aligned learning for UK children aged 5-11, covering KS1, KS2 and SEND learners, with AI voice narration and progress tracking that parents can see.

KokoLearn is a UK home-learning service. Children work through lessons that adapt to them, and parents get visibility of progress.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://kokolearn.org): what KokoLearn is and how it works
- [Pricing](https://kokolearn.org/pricing): plans, including a 24 hour free trial
- [Curriculum](https://kokolearn.org/curriculum): how lessons map to the UK national curriculum
- [For organisations](https://kokolearn.org/for-organisations): schools, tutoring and other organisations
- [What parents see](https://kokolearn.org/what-parents-see): the parent view of progress
- [Blog](https://kokolearn.org/blog): articles on home learning
- [FAQ](https://kokolearn.org/legal/faq)
